 Ariana Grande Debuts Bob Haircut in New Photos
 Ariana Grande 
 Bye Bye Ponytail!!! 
 Add TMZ on Google 
 By TMZ Staff 
 Published 
 October 22, 2026
 12:03 PM PDT 
 Ariana Grande just chopped off her signature hairstyle ... debuting a super short bob in place of her pop star ponytail.
 The singer hopped on social media Thursday to show off her new look, which features a sideswept part and a flip at the ends.
 Her fierce fans and famous friends flooded her comments, gushing about the departure from her iconic pony. Even boyfriend Ricky Alvarez sounded off, saying ... "i wanna ask you out."
 As you know, Ariana's been stepping back from public appearances following the scrutiny she says she received during her "Eternal Sunshine Tour."
 However, she's still been pretty active on social media, promoting personal pics and plugging her makeup brand.
 It seems Ari's gearing up to dip her toes back into professional appearances ... because her press tour for "Focker-In-Law" is coming up.
